kaikki_vikisozluk.e: نَاكَ • (nāka) I (non-past يَنِيكُ (yanīku), verbal noun نَيْك (nayk))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Inherited from Proto-Semitic *nayak-, outside of Arabia only attested by Akkadian 𒈾𒀀𒆪 (nâku). Ultimately from Proto-Afroasiatic; compare Egyptian n:k-D53 (nk).
